info.title: Pixelbadger.Toolkit.Rag
info.description: A CLI toolkit for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows, providing BM25 search indexing, querying, semantic chunking, and MCP server functionality powered by Lucene.NET.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: RAG toolkit for BM25 search indexing, querying, and MCP server functionality powered by Lucene.NET

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Ingest content into a search index with intelligent chunking based on file type

options.name: --index-path
options.description: Path to the Lucene.NET index directory

options.name: --content-path
options.description: Path to the content file or folder to ingest. If a folder is provided, all supported files (.txt, .md) will be ingested.

options.name: --no-vectors
options.description: Disable vector storage and avoid sending document content to OpenAI for embeddings.

options.name: --max-file-size-bytes
options.description: Maximum size in bytes for a single ingested file.

options.name: --max-files
options.description: Maximum number of supported files to ingest from a folder.

options.name: --max-chunk-characters
options.description: Maximum size in characters for a single chunk before indexing or embedding.

options.name: --allow-symlinks
options.description: Allow ingestion of symbolic links and reparse points. Disabled by default to avoid indexing off-root files.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Perform search against an index using BM25, vector, or hybrid modes

options.name: --index-path
options.description: Path to the Lucene.NET index directory

options.name: --max-results
options.description: Maximum number of results to return

options.name: --sourceIds
options.description: Optional list of source IDs to constrain search results

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Host an MCP server that performs BM25 queries against a Lucene.NET index

options.name: --index-path
options.description: Path to the Lucene.NET index directory
